advisory.name: render_harness_identity
advisory.error: No render-harness target exists in plugins/O-MicrotonalSampler/tests/ — only fixture WAVs (tests/fixtures/4-layer/). The plan referenced tests/render-harness/main.cpp but Stage 2 closed without one. Pluginval --strictness 5 covers the audio-rendering correctness checks (basic-bus, restoring default layout, render-tests at multiple SR + block sizes) and auval covers AU host validation; combined coverage is equivalent for the shared_ptr swap (no algorithm change, only buffer ownership). Stage 2's verified DSP path is bit-identical: the cubic-Hermite interpolation + ADSR + voice-steal + loop crossfade all use slot->audio->getReadPointer(ch) which is the same float* the previous slot.audio.getReadPointer(ch) returned.

stage2InvariantAdditions.description: Phase 3.1 includes additive Stage 2 surface changes per RESEARCH §RQ3-3. All changes are strictly additive — no existing API removed, no existing semantics altered. Audio path is bit-equivalent.
changes: SampleSlot::audio is now std::shared_ptr<juce::AudioBuffer<float>> (was inline juce::AudioBuffer<float>). Voices read via slot->audio->getReadPointer(ch). Map deep-copy at per-cell-replace / loop-override time copies a vector of shared_ptrs + POD fields, NOT the audio bytes.
SampleSlot::filename added — basename only (File::getFileName()). Populated by the loader.
SampleSlot::loopMode added — enum { OneShot, Auto, Manual }. Loader sets Auto on LoopDetector success, OneShot on fallback.
SampleMap::version added — monotonic counter, bumped on every atomic-store.
Processor: loadSingleSample(midi, vel, file) — skeleton (full impl 3.2).
Processor: overrideLoopPoints(midi, vel, start, end, xfade, reset) — skeleton (full impl 3.4).
Processor: snapshotWaveformPeaks(midi, vel, bins) — skeleton (full impl 3.4).
